hook.text: The same stock can look bullish on a daily chart and bearish on a 5-minute chart. Both are correct.

buildup.text: Each candle represents a period: 1 minute, 5 minutes, 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week—you choose the lens.

discovery.text: Shorter timeframes show noise and fast moves. Longer timeframes reveal the dominant trend.

twist.text: Most beginners trade too short a timeframe, mistaking noise for signals and overtrading as a result.

climax.text: Multi-timeframe analysis—checking weekly, daily, and hourly—gives the fullest picture of market structure.

punchline.text: Zoom out before you zoom in.

quiz.question: What is multi-timeframe analysis?
options: Checking several chart timeframes to confirm a signal
